natural.name: Grown
natural.how: Naturals grow somewhere in the world. You'll sign harvest contracts for them on the map in the back room.

synthetic.name: Catalogue
synthetic.how: Aroma chemicals come from the supplier's catalogue. You'll order them, and they ship to the shop.

tiers.name: Your first bench
tiers.teaches: One material for each layer, plus a herb: enough for an amber and a cologne.

tiers.name: Lift and glow
tiers.teaches: Modern helpers that make a blend bigger and longer, and a first spice.

tiers.name: Green and creamy
tiers.teaches: Leaves, cut grass and lactones: everything a fig needs, plus a dry wood.

tiers.name: Moss and earth
tiers.teaches: The chypre: oakmoss and patchouli under a rose heart, with coumarin's hay.

tiers.name: The barbershop
tiers.teaches: Fresh fougères and the forest: clean, bright and resinous.

tiers.name: Fruit and flowers
tiers.teaches: Rich roses, violets, orchard fruit and tea.

tiers.name: Sparkle and skin
tiers.teaches: Aldehydic sparkle and soft musk: the finishing touches.
